definition: The InversionResult bundle from the lightcurve-inversion pipeline: estimated q0 + omega0, fit metrics (chi-squared, RMS residual), parameter uncertainties (Fisher or MCMC), and the predicted/observed light curves with their observation times (plus omega_history / MCMC samples when present). Richer than a bare q0-omega-state — it is the whole solved-inversion record, not just the recovered state.
